settings.mission_text: To make tree plantation a normal, everyday act of community life in Bangladesh — by giving any group of neighbours the saplings, training and support they need to green the land around them, and by tracking every tree planted so the country can see its own progress.
settings.vision_text: A Bangladesh where every school has a shaded courtyard, every coastline has a living mangrove barrier, and every city street has a canopy overhead — rebuilt tree by tree by the people who live there, not handed down from outside.

about.banner.heading: Our story so far
about.banner.body: We started with a handful of volunteers and one riverside neighbourhood. Today we're a nationwide movement — but the way we work hasn't changed.

about.story1.heading: A neighbourhood clean-up that grew into a movement
about.story1.body:
Green Bangladesh began in 2019 when a small group of university students in Dhaka started replacing littered vacant lots with saplings. What started as weekend clean-ups turned into a structured plantation program once local schools and community leaders asked to get involved.

Since then, we've built a simple model: local teams identify land that needs trees, we supply saplings and training, and volunteers do the planting and the follow-up care. Every tree is logged, photographed and mapped, so anyone can see exactly where the movement has reached.

about.story2.heading: Local teams, national reach
about.story2.body:
We now run 185+ active teams spread across all eight divisions, each led by volunteers from that community. Teams choose their own planting sites — schoolyards, riverbanks, coastal belts, roadside strips — based on what their area actually needs.

Head office in Dhaka handles sapling sourcing, training materials and the live tracking platform. Everything else — the digging, the watering, the years of aftercare — is done by people planting trees where they live.

about_values.title: Community-led
about_values.text: Every site is chosen and planted by the people who live there — not decided from a head office.

about_values.title: Radically transparent
about_values.text: Every tree we count is mapped, dated and photographed. Anyone can check our numbers.

about_values.title: Aftercare first
about_values.text: A planted tree isn't a finished job. Teams commit to watering and monitoring for at least two years.

about_values.title: Education-driven
about_values.text: Most drives include a short session on why the species and site were chosen, not just a shovel.

about_values.title: Open to everyone
about_values.text: No experience, equipment or fee required — we provide saplings, tools and guidance on the day.

about_values.title: Climate-conscious
about_values.text: Species are matched to local soil and flood risk, with extra focus on coastal mangrove belts.
